bugs_found: transfer credits the source account instead of debiting it, creating money
transfer does not normalize or type-check amount as Decimal, so floats/strings can crash or introduce mixed-type behavior
transfer is non-atomic and has no concurrency protection, so balance checks can race or partial mutation can leave inconsistent balances
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year with int(), changing caller intent without validation
compound_interest allows negative principal, which can produce nonsensical negative balances/returns
fx_convert does not validate rate positivity, allowing zero or negative exchange rates
